title: Improved Friedgut small family
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, real parameters $[epsilon]$ and $[eta]$, and a natural number $k$, let $T$ be the improved Friedgut threshold determined by $f$, $[epsilon]$, $[eta]$, and $k$. The improved Friedgut small family consists of all sets of coordinates $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ that are contained in the influential coordinates of $f$ at threshold $T$ and satisfy $|S|\le k$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
caveat: The payload omits the definitions of the improved Friedgut threshold and influential coordinates, so their precise meanings cannot be spelled out here.
